description: New Delhi [India], January 29: DPIFS Solutions Private Limited under the leadership of Darpan Jayraj Kale has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Government of Uttar Pradesh at Davos, Switzerland, to establish large-scale AI-enabled smart traffic management and urban surveillance infrastructure across multiple cities in the state. The MoU was executed on 21 January 2026 on the sidelines of the World Economic Forum (WEF) Annual Meeting 2026, under the Invest UP initiative.
body_lead: DPIFS Solutions Signs Rs 3,800 Crore MoU with Government of Uttar Pradesh at Davos for AI-Enabled Smart Infrastructure VMPL New Delhi [India], January 29: DPIFS Solutions Private Limited under the leadership of Darpan Jayraj Kale has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Government of Uttar Pradesh at Davos, Switzerland, to establish large-scale AI-enabled smart traffic management and urban surveillance infrastructure across multiple cities in the state.
